title: TrueSpyglass
description: A mod that adds the ability to change the zoom on the spyglass.
body:
# A mod that adds the ability to change the zoom level on the spyglass.

### To do this:
1. Hold down the right mouse button
1. Roll the mouse wheel

_The mod was created for **1.20.1 FORGE**, but there may be versions for **Fabric 1.20.1+** in the future._
